meta.name: Apple Cider Vinegar
meta.description: Two young women advocate for wellness remedies to cure deadly illnesses, unraveling their lives as they unknowingly — and knowingly — mislead the world.

videos.title: Toxic
videos.overview: A rare and unexpected diagnosis puts Milla's carefree life on hold. Belle's anxieties begin to spiral when her baby shower doesn't go as planned.

videos.title: Clean Sheets
videos.overview: Milla takes her treatment into her own hands. Belle turns to Clive, a shy IT expert, for comfort. An enamored Belle meets Milla for the first time.

videos.title: Pink Dolphins
videos.overview: In the wake of devastating news, Clive struggles to cope while Belle dives into work. Lucy's frustrations grow as Justin digs into Belle's past.

videos.title: Mama Aya
videos.overview: Lucy seeks new experiences on a mind-bending trip to Peru. Chanelle joins Belle as her popularity soars, and Milla's world begins to unravel.

videos.title: Casseroles
videos.overview: As scrutiny mounts, Belle faces tough questions about her health. Milla turns to family for help while Justin finds a new angle for his article.

videos.title: Tapeworm
videos.overview: At a funeral, Belle scrambles to stick to her story, but the article yields surprising reactions. Can her wellness empire survive a web of lies?

meta.slogan: A true-ish story, based on a lie.
